subject.title: [Bug]: Config validator rejects mediaLocalRoots despite type definitions supporting it (Telegram outbound)

question: Should OpenClaw expose configurable outbound local media roots for this Telegram/media-send class, and if so should the canonical surface be shared filesystem/media policy rather than `channels.telegram.mediaLocalRoots` or `agents.defaults.mediaLocalRoots`?
rationale: Current main has a newer read-policy expansion path, but the requested config key remains rejected and any root allowlist changes a security-sensitive host file-read/upload boundary.

options.title: Use canonical tools/fs policy
options.body: Define the supported root surface in the shared filesystem/media policy and close or redirect channel-specific `mediaLocalRoots` requests once that is available.

options.title: Add Telegram-scoped roots
options.body: Accept a channel-specific config knob and own the resulting parallel security and docs surface for Telegram outbound media.

options.title: Keep staging-only media roots
options.body: Decline configurable external roots and document the existing temp/media/workspace staging model plus `tools.fs.workspaceOnly=false` behavior.

recommendation.title: Use canonical tools/fs policy
recommendation.body: Define the supported root surface in the shared filesystem/media policy and close or redirect channel-specific `mediaLocalRoots` requests once that is available.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed the current-main media-root expansion and read-capability boundary.
